title: Opening a Bank Account
context: Ava 刚搬到附近，走进银行想开一个支票账户；她向柜员 Mason 说明是第一次办理，出示驾照和账单作为身份与地址证明，并询问借记卡、最低存款和日后如何查询余额。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: Hi. I'd like to open a checking account, please.
dialogue.zh: 你好。我想开一个支票账户。

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: Of course. Have you banked with us before?
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。你以前在我们这里办过业务吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: No, this is my first time. I just moved to the neighborhood.
dialogue.zh: 没有，这是第一次。我刚搬到这附近。

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: Welcome. I'll need a photo ID and proof of your current address.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎。我需要一份带照片的身份证明，以及你现在住址的证明。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: Sure. I have my driver's license and a utility bill.
dialogue.zh: 好的。我带了驾照和一份水电账单。

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: That's perfect. There's no monthly fee if you set up direct deposit.
dialogue.zh: 非常合适。如果你设置工资直存，就没有月费。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: That works for me. Can I get a debit card today?
dialogue.zh: 这对我没问题。今天能拿到借记卡吗？

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: The card will be mailed in five to seven days. You can use it as soon as it arrives.
dialogue.zh: 卡会在五到七天内寄出。寄到后就可以用了。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: Okay. Is there a minimum deposit to open the account?
dialogue.zh: 好的。开户有最低存款要求吗？

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: Yes. You can start with twenty-five dollars today.
dialogue.zh: 有的。今天先存二十五美元就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: Great. I'll deposit that now. How do I check my balance later?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我现在就存。以后怎么查询余额呢？

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: You can use our mobile app, or check at an ATM anytime.
dialogue.zh: 你可以用我们的手机应用，也可以随时在自动取款机上查询。

expressions.zh: 开一个支票账户。在银行说明办理业务时常用。
expressions.example: I'd like to open a checking account, please.

expressions.en: Have you banked with us before?
expressions.zh: 你以前在我们这里办过业务吗？工作人员确认是否为新客户时常用。
expressions.example: Have you banked with us before?

expressions.zh: 现在住址的证明。开户时常用水电账单或租约来证明住址。
expressions.example: I'll need a photo ID and proof of your current address.

expressions.zh: 设置工资或收入直存。银行说明免月费条件时常用。
expressions.example: There's no monthly fee if you set up direct deposit.

expressions.zh: 最低存款。询问或说明开户起步金额时常用。
expressions.example: Is there a minimum deposit to open the account?

pronunciation: 练习 checking account 的节奏：CHECKing acCOUNT。注意 deposit 作名词时重音在前：DE-po-sit，debit 的重音在前：DE-bit，以及 utility 的重音在第二音节：u-TI-li-ty。

practice.title: Part 1 · Banks and money
practice.prompt: Do you usually pay with a bank card, or do you still use cash? Why?
practice.answer: I usually pay with a debit card because it is convenient and I can check my balance in an app. I only use cash for small things, like a snack or a bus ticket.

practice.title: Part 2 · A time you visited a bank
practice.prompt: Describe a time you went to a bank. Say why you went, what you needed to bring, and what happened.
practice.answer: Last month I went to a bank to open a checking account after I moved. I brought my driver's license and a utility bill. The clerk said there was no monthly fee with direct deposit, and my debit card would arrive in about a week. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Banking in daily life
practice.prompt: Why do some people still visit a bank in person instead of using an app?
practice.answer: Some people want to ask questions face to face, especially when they open an account or have a problem. Others may feel apps are hard to use, or they prefer to handle money in person. Banks in the neighborhood can also feel more trustworthy for important tasks.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读。最后练习说明你要开什么账户、需要带哪些证件，以及如何查询余额。
practice.answer: 用 3–4 句说明你会怎么在银行开户：账户类型、身份和地址证明、最低存款，以及日后如何查余额。
